nodes.description: Mapping(address=>bool) public whitelist in UniMex controlling who may transfer while locked.
Bool public locked flag that gates transfer and transferFrom.
Private address _owner in Ownable used by the onlyOwner modifier.
unlock() onlyOwner sets locked to false.
lock() onlyOwner sets locked to true.
addToWhitelist(address _user) onlyOwner sets whitelist[_user]=true.
removeFromWhitelist(address _user) onlyOwner sets whitelist[_user]=false.
mint(address _to,uint256 _amount) onlyOwner mints new tokens via _mint.
transfer(address to,uint256 amount) override; enforces locked/owner/whitelist then calls super.transfer.
transferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 amount) override; enforces locked/owner/whitelist then calls super.transferFrom.
msg.sender used for owner and whitelist authorization in transfer and transferFrom.
Internal _mint(_to,_amount) execution that increases total supply and balances.
super.transfer(to,amount) ERC20 balance mutation executed under locked gating.
super.transferFrom(from,to,amount) ERC20 balance/allowance mutation under locked gating.
Parameter _user of addToWhitelist, used as whitelist mapping key.
Parameter _user of removeFromWhitelist, used as whitelist mapping key.
Parameter _to of mint, recipient of newly minted tokens.
Parameter _amount of mint, amount of tokens to create.
Parameter to of transfer, recipient address.
Parameter amount of transfer, amount moved.
Parameter from of transferFrom, source address checked against owner/whitelist.
Parameter to of transferFrom, recipient address.
Parameter amount of transferFrom, amount moved.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner() and used to index whitelist in transfer.
msg.sender is compared to owner() and used to index whitelist in transferFrom (via from parameter).
The locked flag gates the authorization branch of transfer.
The locked flag gates the authorization branch of transferFrom.
whitelist[msg.sender] read to authorize transfer while locked.
whitelist[from] read to authorize transferFrom while locked.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals _msgSender before unlock executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals _msgSender before lock executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals _msgSender before addToWhitelist executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals _msgSender before removeFromWhitelist executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals _msgSender before mint executes.
unlock writes locked = false.
lock writes locked = true.
addToWhitelist writes whitelist[_user] = true, granting transfer permission.
removeFromWhitelist writes whitelist[_user] = false, revoking transfer permission.
mint invokes the internal _mint operation.
transfer delegates to super.transfer after the gating checks.
transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom after the gating checks.
_user parameter is written as key into the whitelist mapping.
_user parameter is written as key into the whitelist mapping.
_to parameter flows into the mint recipient.
_amount parameter flows into _mint totalSupply and balance arithmetic.
to parameter flows to super.transfer recipient.
amount parameter flows into ERC20 balance subtraction/addition.
from parameter is checked against owner() and whitelist in transferFrom.
to parameter flows to super.transferFrom recipient.
amount parameter flows into allowance and balance arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _user only exists to key the whitelist write performed by addToWhitelist; merge into that core function.
Parameter _user only exists to key the whitelist write performed by removeFromWhitelist; merge into that core function.
Parameter _to is only consumed by the mint core function as the mint recipient.
Parameter _amount is only consumed by the mint core function for token creation arithmetic.
Parameter to is only used by the transfer core function as recipient.
Parameter amount is only used by the transfer core function for balance arithmetic.
Parameter from is only used by the transferFrom core function for owner/whitelist authorization.
Parameter to is only used by the transferFrom core function as recipient.
Parameter amount is only used by the transferFrom core function for allowance/balance arithmetic.
